newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.88 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.88 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 101.64421 UDIs and a real return of 6.88 percent at the primary auction on Monday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds had a real return of 7.19 percent.
Demand this week was 1.04 billion UDIs compared to 300 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.47.
Two weeks ago demand was 1.49 billion UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.96.
